post.summary:
Register a new charity or donor organization account.
Returns 201 Created with a message to check email for verification.
post.description:
AccountType: 0 (Charity), 1 (DonorOrganization)

Field Constraints:
- AccountType: Required, valid AccountType enum
- Name: Required, 3-200 characters
- Username: Required, 3-50 characters, must be unique
- Email: Required, valid email format, must be unique
- Phone: Required, valid phone format
- Description: Optional, 10-1000 characters
- Password: Required, minimum 5 characters
- ConfirmPassword: Required, must match Password
- Whatsapp: Optional
- City: Optional
- Governorate: Optional
- PostalCode: Optional

requestBody.description: Registration details including account type, name, username, email, phone, password, and optional profile information.

201.description: Account created successfully. Verification email sent.

400.description: Validation error - invalid input or account type.

post.summary:
Login with username or email and password.
Requires email to be verified first.
post.description:
Field Constraints:
- UsernameOrEmail: Required, valid username or email
- Password: Required, minimum 5 characters
- RememberMe: Optional, boolean for extended session (default false)

requestBody.description: Login credentials including username or email and password.

200.description: Login successful. Returns access token and refresh token.

403.description: Email not verified OR account is deactivated.

post.summary: Get a new access token using a valid refresh token.
post.description:
Field Constraints:
- RefreshToken: Required, valid refresh token string

requestBody.description: Refresh token request containing the refresh token.

200.description: Token refreshed successfully. Returns new access token and refresh token.

post.summary: Logout the authenticated user and revoke their refresh token.

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid or missing authentication token.

get.summary: Verify email address using the token sent to the user's email.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The verification token sent to the user's email.

post.summary: Resend the email verification link to the user's email address.
post.description:
Field Constraints:
- Email: Required, valid email format

requestBody.description: Request containing the email address to verify.

404.description: User not found or already verified.

get.summary:
Returns aggregated statistics for the authenticated charity's dashboard.
Includes charity need counts (by status), need applications received,
and offer applications sent — all broken down by status.

post.summary:
Creates a new charity need for the authenticated charity.
The need is created with status Pending and must be approved by admin
before it becomes visible to donor organizations.
Accepts multipart/form-data to support an optional product image.
post.description:
Category: 0 (Food), 1 (Clothing), 2 (Medical), 3 (Education), 4 (Other)

Priority: 0 (Urgent), 1 (High), 2 (Normal), 3 (Low)

Unit: 0 (Ton), 1 (Kg), 2 (Gram), 3 (Liter), 4 (Ml), 5 (Pack), 6 (Box), 7 (Can), 8 (Piece)

Field Constraints:
- Category: Required, valid ProductCategory enum (0-4)
- ProductName: Required, max 200 characters
- Quantity: Required, minimum 0.01
- Unit: Required, valid MeasurementUnit enum (0-8)
- Priority: Required, valid CharityNeedPriority enum (0-3)
- ProductImage: Optional, allowed formats: .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .webp, max 2MB

403.description: Charity account is not verified or active.

get.summary:
Returns a paginated list of the authenticated charity's own needs.
All statuses are visible to the owner (Pending, Approved, Rejected, Fulfilled).
Optionally filtered by status.
get.description:
Category: 0 (Food), 1 (Clothing), 2 (Medical), 3 (Education), 4 (Other)

Priority: 0 (Urgent), 1 (High), 2 (Normal), 3 (Low)

Status: 0 (Pending), 1 (Approved), 2 (Rejected), 3 (Fulfilled)

Field Constraints (query):
- Page: Optional, default 1, minimum 1
- PageSize: Optional, default 10, max 50
- Status: Optional, valid CharityNeedStatus enum (0-3)

Returns the full profile of the authenticated user.
Includes contact information, location details, and profile image URL.

put.summary:
Updates the authenticated user's contact and location fields.
All fields are optional — only non-null values are applied.
put.description:
Field Constraints:
- Phone: Optional, valid phone number format
- Whatsapp: Optional, valid phone number format
- City: Optional, max 100 characters
- Governorate: Optional, max 100 characters
- PostalCode: Optional, max 20 characters

requestBody.description: Profile update details including phone, whatsapp, city, governorate, and postal code.

patch.summary:
Changes the authenticated user's password.
Requires the current password to be verified before setting a new password.
patch.description:
Field Constraints:
- CurrentPassword: Required, must match the current password
- NewPassword: Required, minimum 5 characters
- ConfirmPassword: Required, must match NewPassword

requestBody.description: Password change details including current password, new password, and confirmation.

400.description: Validation error or current password is incorrect.

patch.summary:
Updates the authenticated user's profile image.
Accepts multipart/form-data with the image file.
patch.description:
Field Constraints:
- ProfileImage: Required, allowed formats: .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .webp, max 2MB
